acceptanceCriteria: A platform-neutral shared-domain module is imported by both app targets and a unit-test target.
The dependency structure documents separate responsibilities for domain logic, persistence, synchronization, UI state and real-time audio.
The architecture specifies that the audio render path cannot allocate, block, perform file I/O or mutate UI-observed state.
notes: Planning only; SP-001 activation and implementation require explicit user authorization.
Create foundation structure and document boundaries only; pitch models, persistence, synchronization and audio implementation remain in later Epics.
rationale: Establish the shared module and architecture boundaries. Provides a bounded, separately reviewable foundation outcome.
testSteps: Compile shared-module imports in both apps and execute the shared test target.
Inspect the dependency graph for platform/UI coupling in the domain module.
